اخضوضعن (form XII)
# اِخْضَوْضَعْنَ (iḵḍawḍaʕna) /ix.dˤaw.dˤaʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْضَوْضَعَ (iḵḍawḍaʕa)
# اِخْضَوْضِعْنَ (iḵḍawḍiʕna) /ix.dˤaw.dˤiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْضَوْضَعَ (iḵḍawḍaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
